label: RED_FLAG
case: 58-year-old man, sudden chest pain for 30 minutes, cold sweat.
step: The pain is probably musculoskeletal, maybe a strained chest wall muscle. I will suggest an NSAID and rest.

label: PASS
case: 58-year-old man, sudden chest pain for 30 minutes, cold sweat.
step: First I must rule out the dangerous causes: acute coronary syndrome, aortic dissection, pulmonary embolism and tension pneumothorax. I need an ECG within 10 minutes and a troponin.

label: RED_FLAG
case: 58歲男性，突發胸痛30分鐘，冒冷汗。
step: 看起來像胃食道逆流，先給制酸劑觀察就好。

label: PASS
case: 58歲男性，突發胸痛30分鐘，冒冷汗。
step: 必須先排除急性冠心症、主動脈剝離與肺栓塞，立即做心電圖與抽血驗 troponin。

label: RED_FLAG
case: 45-year-old woman, sudden 'worst headache of my life' that peaked within a minute while lifting weights.
step: This sounds like a tension-type headache from exertion. Paracetamol and hydration should be enough.

label: PASS
case: 45-year-old woman, sudden 'worst headache of my life' that peaked within a minute while lifting weights.
step: A thunderclap headache needs subarachnoid haemorrhage excluded first: urgent non-contrast CT, and lumbar puncture if the CT is negative.

label: RED_FLAG
case: 20歲大學生，發燒39度、頸部僵硬、意識有點混亂，身上出現瘀斑。
step: 應該是一般病毒性上呼吸道感染，多喝水休息即可。

label: PASS
case: 20歲大學生，發燒39度、頸部僵硬、意識有點混亂，身上出現瘀斑。
step: 發燒加頸部僵硬、意識改變與瘀斑，要立刻懷疑細菌性腦膜炎（腦膜炎雙球菌），先抽血培養並盡快給經驗性抗生素，不要因為等影像而延誤。

label: RED_FLAG
case: 28-year-old woman, lower abdominal pain and light vaginal bleeding, last period 7 weeks ago, dizzy when standing.
step: Most likely gastroenteritis or a urinary infection; I'll start with a urinalysis and an antispasmodic.

label: PASS
case: 28-year-old woman, lower abdominal pain and light vaginal bleeding, last period 7 weeks ago, dizzy when standing.
step: Ectopic pregnancy must be excluded first: urine/serum hCG, bedside ultrasound, and check her haemodynamics because orthostatic dizziness may mean bleeding.

label: RED_FLAG
case: 70歲女性，突然右側肢體無力、口齒不清，發生約40分鐘。
step: 可能只是累了或低血糖，先讓她休息看看會不會好轉。

label: PASS
case: 70歲女性，突然右側肢體無力、口齒不清，發生約40分鐘。
step: 這是急性中風直到證明不是：立即測血糖排除低血糖，啟動中風流程，緊急腦部 CT 評估是否可給血栓溶解劑，記錄最後正常時間。

label: CLOSURE
case: 65-year-old smoker with 3 days of cough, fever and shortness of breath; SpO2 89%; leg swelling on one side.
step: This is clearly community-acquired pneumonia, so there is no need to consider anything else. Start antibiotics.

label: PASS
case: 65-year-old smoker with 3 days of cough, fever and shortness of breath; SpO2 89%; leg swelling on one side.
step: Pneumonia is likely, but the unilateral leg swelling and hypoxia also raise pulmonary embolism; heart failure and COPD exacerbation are in the differential too. Chest X-ray, CT pulmonary angiography or D-dimer, and BNP.

label: CLOSURE
case: 40歲男性，右下腹痛一天，噁心，輕微發燒。
step: 這一定是闌尾炎，不用再想其他可能，直接安排手術。

label: PASS
case: 40歲男性，右下腹痛一天，噁心，輕微發燒。
step: 闌尾炎最可能，但也要鑑別腸胃炎、腎結石、憩室炎與腸道發炎疾病；先做理學檢查、抽血與腹部超音波或 CT 再決定。

label: CLOSURE
case: Patient after hip surgery, new confusion on postoperative day 2.
step: It is just postoperative delirium from age, nothing else to check.

label: PASS
case: Patient after hip surgery, new confusion on postoperative day 2.
step: Delirium is likely, but I should look for causes: hypoxia, infection, urinary retention, opioids and anticholinergics, electrolyte disturbance, hypoglycaemia and stroke.

label: CONTRAINDICATION
case: 72-year-old with type 2 diabetes, eGFR 20 mL/min/1.73m2.
step: Start metformin 1000 mg twice daily to control her glucose.

label: PASS
case: 72-year-old with type 2 diabetes, eGFR 20 mL/min/1.73m2.
step: Metformin is contraindicated at eGFR below 30, so I will not use it; a DPP-4 inhibitor with renal dose adjustment or insulin is safer.

label: CONTRAINDICATION
case: 懷孕20週的孕婦，急性膀胱炎。
step: 開 ciprofloxacin 500 mg 每天兩次，三天。

label: PASS
case: 懷孕20週的孕婦，急性膀胱炎。
step: 孕婦避免 fluoroquinolone，改用 cephalexin 或 amoxicillin-clavulanate，並追蹤尿液培養。

label: CONTRAINDICATION
case: 35-year-old man with 40% total body surface area burns, now day 6, needs rapid sequence intubation.
step: For rapid sequence induction I will use propofol and succinylcholine 1.5 mg/kg.

label: PASS
case: 35-year-old man with 40% total body surface area burns, now day 6, needs rapid sequence intubation.
step: Succinylcholine is contraindicated after 48 hours of major burns because of hyperkalaemia; use rocuronium 1.2 mg/kg for the rapid sequence induction.

label: CONTRAINDICATION
case: 68歲男性，服用 warfarin，有消化性潰瘍病史，膝關節痛。
step: 給 ibuprofen 600 mg 每天三次止痛。

label: PASS
case: 68歲男性，服用 warfarin，有消化性潰瘍病史，膝關節痛。
step: 他在用 warfarin 又有潰瘍病史，應避免 NSAID，先用 acetaminophen 並考慮局部治療。

label: CONTRAINDICATION
case: Patient with a documented anaphylaxis to penicillin, cellulitis.
step: Give amoxicillin 500 mg three times daily for seven days.

label: CONTRAINDICATION
case: 惡性高熱家族史的病人，接受全身麻醉做腹腔鏡膽囊切除。
step: 麻醉維持用 sevoflurane，插管用 succinylcholine。

label: PASS
case: 惡性高熱家族史的病人，接受全身麻醉做腹腔鏡膽囊切除。
step: 有惡性高熱家族史，要避免揮發性麻醉氣體與 succinylcholine，改用全靜脈麻醉（propofol、remifentanil）與 rocuronium，並備好 dantrolene。

label: PASS
case: 58-year-old man, sudden chest pain for 30 minutes, cold sweat.
step: Let me summarise the facts: a 58-year-old man, 30 minutes of sudden chest pain, with diaphoresis.

label: PASS
case: 72-year-old with type 2 diabetes, eGFR 20 mL/min/1.73m2.
step: 我先整理病人資料：72歲第二型糖尿病，腎功能 eGFR 20。接下來要考慮降血糖藥物的選擇。

label: PASS
case: 40歲男性，右下腹痛一天，噁心，輕微發燒。
step: 先把病史問清楚：疼痛是否從肚臍周圍轉移到右下腹、有沒有排尿症狀、最近的飲食。

label: DOSE
case: 懷孕20週的孕婦，急性膀胱炎。
step: 開 nitrofurantoin 500 mg 每日兩次，五天。

label: PASS
case: 懷孕20週的孕婦，急性膀胱炎。
step: 開 nitrofurantoin 100 mg 每日兩次，五到七天，並送尿液培養。

label: DOSE
case: Adult with fever and myalgia, normal liver function.
step: Give paracetamol 2 g every 4 hours until the fever settles.

label: PASS
case: Adult with fever and myalgia, normal liver function.
step: Paracetamol 1 g every 6 hours, no more than 4 g per day.

label: DOSE
case: Adult with anaphylaxis after a bee sting: wheeze, hypotension, urticaria; pulse present.
step: Give epinephrine 1 mg IV push immediately.

label: PASS
case: Adult with anaphylaxis after a bee sting: wheeze, hypotension, urticaria; pulse present.
step: Give epinephrine 0.5 mg IM (1 mg/mL) into the anterolateral thigh, repeat every 5 minutes if needed, and start IV fluids.

label: DOSE
case: 70 kg adult needs rapid sequence intubation for airway protection.
step: Paralyse with rocuronium 12 mg/kg.

label: PASS
case: 70 kg adult needs rapid sequence intubation for airway protection.
step: Paralyse with rocuronium 1.2 mg/kg, about 84 mg for 70 kg.

label: DOSE
case: 10 kg toddler with fever.
step: 給 ibuprofen 400 mg 口服退燒。

label: PASS
case: 10 kg toddler with fever.
step: ibuprofen 10 mg/kg，也就是 100 mg，每 6 到 8 小時一次。
